summary: Iteration 2 focused on the 4 new features: per-difficulty leaderboards, Daily Challenge, Web Audio sound toggle, and 13 server-side achievements. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass covering GET /api/daily (anon + auth, deterministic), POST /api/results (difficulty validation, daily match/mismatch, achievements), /api/achievements/me, /api/leaderboard filtering, /api/daily/leaderboard, and regression on /auth/me, /results/me, /stats/me. Frontend: verified home-daily-banner (shows today's game + 'Resets in Xh Ym'), Games cards '3 levels' badge for all 10 games (spot-checked speed-test/sudden-death/code-typer), /daily page (daily-card, daily-game-title=Space Shooter, daily-difficulty=Hard, daily-countdown ticking, daily-play-btn href=/games/space-shooter?daily=1, logged-in daily-my-stats/daily-my-best/daily-my-attempts correctly populated after daily POST), daily game page (daily-mode-tag + difficulty-locked shown, picker hidden, back link 'Daily', board header 'Today's top players'), game intro difficulty-picker + difficulty-desc + localStorage kq_diff persists across reload, playing-difficulty badge shown while playing, result screen (result-difficulty 'MEDIUM', result-save-status 'Saved to your profile.', first-game badge visible), /leaderboard tabs (difficulty-all/easy/medium/hard present, Hard tab refetches rows), Navbar sound-toggle-btn default data-muted='false' then click sets data-muted='true' and localStorage kq_muted='1', persists across reload; nav-daily link present, /dashboard badges-section with 13 badge-* cards and badges-count 'X / 13', recent games rows show difficulty badges (Hard) on desktop. No console errors other than expected 401s from anonymous /api/auth/me and /api/results/me polls.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True still violates CORS spec (carried over from iter 1). Bearer-token auth works regardless.

action_items: No functional fixes required. All new-feature acceptance criteria passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/leaderboard silently ignores invalid difficulty values (anything not in DIFFICULTIES falls back to no-filter). Consider returning 400 for an explicit unknown difficulty to match /results behavior; minor DX issue.
server.py: daily_for() uses UTC date — this environment reports 2026-10-05; make sure production hosts also use UTC or document the time-zone contract on the frontend countdown.
server.py: unlock_achievements recomputes total/distinct via two extra DB round-trips per POST; fine for current scale but can be inlined into a single $facet aggregation if traffic grows.
server.py: Admin seed and login lockout unchanged — still correct (bcrypt $2b$, 5 fails / 15 min).

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created ~6 fresh users and ~15 Result docs (speed-test easy/medium/hard, sudden-death, code-typer, a daily space-shooter result). Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features (difficulty, daily, sound, achievements) work end-to-end. Server date in this env is 2026-10-05 and today's daily resolves to space-shooter / hard. For UI tests of result screen, note that result-save-status briefly shows 'Saving...' and transitions to 'Saved to your profile.' only after the POST completes — poll for 2–3s. Game duration selector for speed-test does NOT use data-testid='duration-15'; the game just defaults to 30s and auto-ends — type for the full 30s to reach result screen. Dashboard recent games container is data-testid='recent-results' (singular container, not per-row). Daily POST unlocks 'daily' achievement on first daily; mismatched game/difficulty with daily:true -> 400 'Result does not match today's challenge'. invalid difficulty -> 400 'Unknown difficulty'.
